nhook.text: Copy trading. What gets copied, and what stays yours?

ncook.text: Think of a cooking class. The chef cooks at the front, and you copy each step, in your own pot.

ntwist.text: And the twist? You don't even lift the spoon.

npot.text: Your pot is your own account.

nauto.text: So what gets copied? The strategy's trades, into your account, automatically. You don't pick the trades.

nyours.text: And what stays yours? Your own account, and your choices. You pick the strategy, how much to put in, and when to stop.

nlid.text: Want to see it for yourself? Your pot has a glass lid: the MetaTrader five app. With your investor password, you can watch every trade, read-only.

nrecap.text: So that's copying. The trades get copied. Your money stays in your own account, you make your three choices, and you can watch every trade.

deposit.text: Your deposit goes into an M T five account at TAG Markets, in your name.

copyx.text: Then you connect a strategy through CopyX.

perf.text: A thirty percent performance fee, taken from profits only.
